prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE single full-bleed portrait 2:3 illustration for part 1 of a Japanese manga-inspired story cover set, FULL COLOR, premium clean ink linework, expressive manga faces, delicate watercolor/gouache color rendering, detailed but readable at phone thumbnail size. No text, lettering, logos, panels, typography, or watermark. Main characters for all covers: Amy, a small living cloth-and-cotton doll girl, childlike proportions, short softly curled chestnut-brown bob with straight fringe, large gentle dark-blue eyes, a tiny red ribbon on her left side, ivory fabric skin with subtle sewing stitches at wrists, a red-burgundy pinafore dress over cream long-sleeved blouse, little brown boots. Her father is an elderly kind craftsman with wispy silver hair, round spectacles, a short silver beard, sage shirt and warm beige waistcoat. Scene: Amy smiling and carefully offering a small yellow flower to her father in his cozy wooden doll-making workshop; father warmly looking down at her, spool of red thread and cloth scraps on the sewing desk. Both Amy arms are present and visible. A sunlit window and hanging fabric establish a handmade home. Honey amber, dusty rose, rich burgundy and jade accents; warm afternoon shafts of sunlight. Elegant cinematic cover composition with Amy in lower center and father upper right, clearly readable large silhouettes. Original illustration, not a reproduction of any existing manga panel or cover. Preserve gentle emotional family tone.

Use case: illustration-story. Transform the supplied illustration into a DIFFERENT portrait 2:3 FULL COLOR manga cover for part 2, 'The other daughter', with NO lettering, title, typography, logos or watermark. The reference locks the exact character designs and the polished colored manga/watercolor illustration style, not the old composition. Keep Amy as this same little stitched cloth doll girl with chestnut bob, small red bow, dark blue eyes, burgundy floral pinafore over cream blouse; keep the elderly father with silver hair/beard, round spectacles, sage shirt and beige waistcoat. Both Amy arms intact. New cover composition: quiet intimate evening inside the workshop. Large three-quarter close-up of Amy in lower foreground tenderly holding a small old framed family photograph, looking thoughtful and a little unsure of herself. In the photograph, a younger version of the father stands beside a human mother and their small human daughter; the photograph is a small supporting element, not a second panel. Behind Amy, present-day elderly father sits by the window gazing away wistfully, softly reflected moonlight in his spectacles. A warm amber desk lamp against rich blue-violet twilight, dusty rose highlights and deep indigo; poignant but gentle. Distinct composition and dramatically cooler palette than reference. Full-bleed illustrated key art, original scene rather than existing manga reproduction. Keep clear large character silhouettes readable as a small book cover.

Use case: illustration-story. Edit the supplied image into a new and different FULL COLOR portrait 2:3 manga story cover for PART 3, the two last letters. Preserve ONLY the character designs, their outfits and the rich colored manga ink-and-watercolor visual style; change composition and environment. No text, letters, title, captions, logos, typography, or watermark. Amy remains the same small cloth doll girl with chestnut curled bob, blue eyes, red bow, burgundy embroidered pinafore and cream blouse, visible stitched cloth hands. Both her arms are intact. The same elderly father, with wispy silver hair, short beard and round spectacles, rests quietly propped up in an ordinary cream bed in his modest home, wearing his sage shirt and beige waistcoat. He is peacefully awake, frail but smiling gently, giving exactly TWO sealed ivory envelopes into Amy's two small cloth hands; the two envelopes are distinct and clearly visible, without any readable writing. Amy beside his bedside looks up with trust and tender concern. Composition: big expressive three-quarter profile of Amy in lower right, father reclining upper left, hands and envelopes at center. A small vase with a yellow flower on bedside table echoes the prior cover. Soft cool jade/emerald evening window light contrasted with warm pink skin and a dim golden bedside lamp. Quiet luminous bittersweet family illustration, beautifully painted cream fabric folds, elegant manga cover art. NO hospital equipment, no injury, no gore, no death scene, no black-and-white rendering. Different scene and camera framing from the reference.

Use case: illustration-story. Transform the reference into a distinctly new FULL COLOR portrait 2:3 manga cover for PART 4, Amy's long journey. Reference is for Amy's exact character identity, clothes and premium colored ink-and-watercolor illustration style ONLY. No text, titles, numbers, typography, logos, watermark or panel grid. Amy is the same small living rag doll, chestnut bob with red bow, gentle blue eyes, cream textile face, burgundy embroidered pinafore over cream blouse. NEW SCENE: full-body lone traveler Amy walking along a wet cobblestone country road toward a distant town, dramatically sweeping storm clouds parting around a stripe of sunset. She wears an old moss-brown hooded cape over her dress. Her CLOTH doll body's RIGHT ARM has fallen off during the journey: show only ONE arm/hand, the LEFT cloth hand clutching a single closed ivory letter tightly to her chest. Anatomical right side has an EMPTY shortened blouse sleeve, visibly tied off as harmless fabric. No exposed human anatomy, no blood or injury: she is an obviously sewn cloth doll. One small boot is worn and muddy, cape frayed at the hem, but her posture is quietly determined. A few wind-blown yellow petals and autumn leaves, reflective puddles, small lights in distant houses. Strong blue-teal and slate-violet rain palette contrasted with red dress and luminous coral-orange horizon. Cinematic low-angle full-body composition, Amy large enough to read at thumbnail size, slightly left of center with road leading behind. Her father is NOT physically present in this cover. Original emotional colored manga book art, not a recreation of an existing manga image.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Make exactly ONE correction to this colored manga illustration. Amy lost her RIGHT boot earlier in the story. The smaller rear foot/boot on the LEFT side of the image must now be a bare ivory sewn cloth doll foot with a visible soft fabric seam, lightly muddy on its underside. Keep her larger foreground boot on the RIGHT side of the image exactly as it is. Keep the missing right arm and tied sleeve, the single left hand holding the envelope, face, hair, ribbon, dress, cape, road, weather, lighting, composition, colors and all other details unchanged. A sewn cloth doll foot, not human skin. No blood, injury or graphic damage. No text. Keep portrait 2:3.

Use case: illustration-story. Transform this image into a DIFFERENT FULL COLOR portrait 2:3 manga cover for PART 5, Amy finds a new home and understands her father's love. Preserve the reference's exact Amy doll identity and colored manga ink-and-watercolor style, change setting and mood completely. No title, text, lettering, logos, watermark or panels. Amy remains a little living cloth doll with chestnut curled bob, red bow, blue eyes, burgundy embroidered dress, cream blouse and sewn cloth face. Her anatomical RIGHT ARM is still missing: the right sleeve is neatly tied off, and only her LEFT cloth hand is visible. New scene: Amy sitting on a wooden bench inside a warm flower shop, holding a single opened ivory letter with her left hand and smiling softly in relief. The letter has no readable writing. A kind older florist woman with silver-streaked brown hair in a bun, cream blouse and sage-green apron leans beside her, gently placing a small yellow flower on Amy's lap. The woman is clearly a new older female character, not the elderly father; the father is not physically present. Waist-up framing, foreground flower bouquets, pink roses, yellow daisies, pale blue hydrangeas, hanging greenery, sunlit glass shop door in background. Vibrant spring green, blush pink, warm cream and sky blue, golden morning light. Gentle happy ending, strong expressive faces, large silhouettes readable at thumbnail size, richly detailed delicate painting. This must feel like a polished standalone manga volume cover and distinct from the stormy journey image. No additional hand on Amy, no repaired arm, no gloves hiding a second arm.
